test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Give yourself a ______ and get some rest.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Break**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **verb** is a phrase or set of words used to denote the occurrence or existence of something, such as bring, happen, be, or do
 
• The word **Break** means to divide or cause to be divided into two or more portions.
 
• *Example* : **Break** this stick into two.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Brake** means the component of a vehicle that slows it down or makes it stop

*Example* : Hit the **brakes** fast.

 
• The word **Blank** means nothing is written, printed, or recorded on it; it is empty.

*Example* : why your answer sheet is **blank**?

 
• The word **Brick** means a durable, baked clay block that is used to construct homes and other structures.

*Example* : She hit me with a **brick**.
